35488-the-road-to-paris-a-story-of-adven.title: The Road To Paris
35488-the-road-to-paris-a-story-of-adven.creator: R. N. Stephens

arxiv-1905-09176.title: Optimal interlayer structure for promoting spreading of SIS model in two-layer networks
arxiv-1905-09176.creator: Liming Pan, Wei Wang, Shimin Cai, Tao Zhou
arxiv-1905-09176.description: Abstract Real-world systems, ranging from social and biological to infrastructural, can be modeled by multilayer networks. Promoting spreading dynamics in multilayer networks may significantly facilitate electronic advertising and predicting popular scientific publications. In this study, we propose a strategy for promoting the spreading dynamics of the susceptible-infected-susceptible model by adding one interconnecting edge between two isolated networks.

arxiv-2006-15440.title: Control of spontaneous emission dynamics in microcavities with chiral exceptional surfaces
arxiv-2006-15440.creator: Q. Zhong, 1 A. Hashemi, 1 Ş. K. Özdemir, 2,3 and R. El-Ganainy 1,4,
arxiv-2006-15440.description: Abstract We investigate spontaneous emission from a quantum emitter located within the mode volume of a microring resonator that features chiral exceptional points. We show that this configuration offers enough degrees of freedom to exhibit a full control to either enhance or suppress the emission process.

arxiv-2102-10424.title: GIST : Distributed Training for Large-Scale Graph Convolutional Networks
arxiv-2102-10424.creator: Cameron R. Wolfe, Jingkang Yang, Fangshuo Liao, Arindam Chowdhury, Chen Dun, Artun Bayer, Santiago Segarra, Anastasios Kyrillidis
arxiv-2102-10424.description: Abstract The graph convolutional network (GCN) is a go-to solution for machine learning on graphs, but its training is notoriously difficult to scale both in terms of graph size and the number of model parameters. Although some work has explored training on large-scale graphs (e.g., GraphSAGE, ClusterGCN, etc.), we pioneer efficient training of large-scale GCN models (i.e.

arxiv-2301-01597.title: Problem-Dependent Power of Quantum Neural Networks on Multi-Class Classification
arxiv-2301-01597.creator: Yuxuan Du, Yibo Yang, Dacheng Tao, Min-Hsiu Hsieh
arxiv-2301-01597.description: Abstract Quantum neural networks (QNNs) have become an important tool for understanding the physical world, but their advantages and limitations are not fully understood. Some QNNs with specific encoding methods can be efficiently simulated by classical surrogates, while others with quantum memory may perform better than classical classifiers.

arxiv-2306-01662.title: A fixed point theorem for COFEs
arxiv-2306-01662.creator: Stephen Dolan
arxiv-2306-01662.description: Abstract 1. Introduction A COFE ( complete ordered family of equivalences ) is a set equipped with an approximate equality (\equiv_{n}) (where a\equiv_{n}b is read as “ a and b are equal for n steps”) and the ability to take certain limits.

arxiv-2306-02010.title: Memorization Capacity of Multi-Head Attention in Transformers
arxiv-2306-02010.creator: Sadegh Mahdavi, Renjie Liao, Christos Thrampoulidis
arxiv-2306-02010.description: Abstract Transformers have become the go-to architecture for language and vision tasks, yet their theoretical properties, especially memorization capacity, remain elusive. This paper investigates the memorization abilities of multi-head attention mechanisms, examining how many example sequences they can memorize, as a function of the number of heads and sequence length.

arxiv-2401-03596.title: On a Stochastic PDE Model for Epigenetic Dynamics
arxiv-2401-03596.creator: Pablo Padilla-Longoria, Jesus Sierra
arxiv-2401-03596.description: Abstract We propose and analyze a stochastic model to investigate epigenetic mutations, i.e., modifications of the genetic information that control gene expression patterns in a cell but do not alter the DNA sequence. Epigenetic mutations are related to environmental fluctuations, which leads us to consider (additive) noise as the driving element for such mutations.

arxiv-2406-16438.title: Constrained velocity-free control of spacecraft attitude via explicit reference governor
arxiv-2406-16438.creator: Qingqing Dang, Wenbo Li, Haichao Gui
arxiv-2406-16438.description: Abstract This paper introduces an explicit reference governor-based control scheme tailored for addressing the velocity-free spacecraft attitude maneuver problem. This problem is subject to specific constraints, namely the pointing constraint, angular velocity constraint, and input saturation. The proposed control scheme operates in two layers, ensuring the asymptotic stability of the spacecraft’s attitude while adhering to the aforementioned constraints.

arxiv-2411-15857.title: Rare Λ c \Lambda_{c} decays and new physics effects
arxiv-2411-15857.creator: Sheng-Qi Zhang, Cong-Feng Qiao
arxiv-2411-15857.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sheng-Qi Zhang, Cong-Feng Qiao. Recent experimental progress on baryonic rare decays has spurred a deeper investigation on flavor-changing neutral current transitions in the baryon sector. Within the framework of QCD sum rules, we derive a complete set of form factors for the Λ c → p \Lambda_{c}\to p process in the large recoil region and use the z z -series parametrization to extrapolate them across the full physical range.

arxiv-2503-00671.title: Newton Polytopes and Analytic Spread
arxiv-2503-00671.creator: Benjamin Drabkin, Benjamin Oltsik
arxiv-2503-00671.description: Abstract . Using the Newton polytope and polyhedron, we study analytic spread and ideal reductions of monomial ideals. We determine a bound for analytic spread based on halfspaces and hyperplanes of the Newton polytope, and we classify basic monomial ideals. We then apply this method to calculate the analytic spread for a few families of monomial ideals.

arxiv-2503-06365.title: Probing D s ∗ D_{s}^{*} -meson longitudinal twist-2 LCDA
arxiv-2503-06365.creator: Si-Hai Zhang, Tao Zhong, Hai-Bing Fu, Ya-Xiong Wang, Wan-Bing Luo
arxiv-2503-06365.description: Abstract In this paper, we carry on an investigation of the semileptonic decays B s → D s ∗ ​ ℓ ​ ν ¯ ℓ B_{s}\to D_{s}^{*}\ell\bar{\nu}_{\ell} . Firstly, we derive the moments of the D s ∗ D_{s}^{*} -meson longitudinal leading-twist light-cone distribution amplitude (LCDA) based on QCD sum rules within background field theory framework.

arxiv-2505-06594.title: Integrating Video and Text: A Balanced Approach to Multimodal Summary Generation and Evaluation
arxiv-2505-06594.creator: Galann Pennec Zhengyuan Liu, Nicholas Asher Philippe Muller Nancy F. Chen
arxiv-2505-06594.description: Abstract Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often struggle to balance visual and textual information when summarizing complex multimodal inputs, such as entire TV show episodes. In this paper, we propose a zero-shot video-to-text summarization approach that builds a screenplay-like representation of an episode, effectively integrating key video moments, dialogue, and character information into a unified document.

arxiv-2506-12765.title: Rethinking Distributional IVs: KAN-Powered D-IV-LATE & Model Choice
arxiv-2506-12765.creator: Charles Shaw. This version August 8, 2026
arxiv-2506-12765.description: Abstract The double/debiased machine learning (DML) framework has become a cornerstone of modern causal inference, allowing researchers to utilise flexible machine learning models for the estimation of nuisance functions without introducing first-order bias into the final parameter estimate. However, the choice of machine learning model for the nuisance functions is often treated as a minor implementation detail.

arxiv-2506-13780.title: Hidden Bias in the Machine: Stereotypes in Text-to-Image Models
arxiv-2506-13780.creator: Sedat Porikli Vedat PorikliCanyon Crest Academy {sedatporikli, vedatporikli}@gmail.com
arxiv-2506-13780.description: Abstract Text-to-Image (T2I) models have transformed visual content creation, producing highly realistic images from natural language prompts. However, concerns persist around their potential to replicate and magnify existing societal biases. To investigate these issues, we curated a diverse set of prompts spanning thematic categories such as occupations, traits, actions, ideologies, emotions, family roles, place descriptions, spirituality, and life events.

arxiv-2511-11085.title: An Approximation Framework for Parametric Matroid Interdiction Problems Journal: Journal of …
arxiv-2511-11085.creator: Nils Hausbrandt, Levin Nemesch, Stefan Ruzika
arxiv-2511-11085.description: Abstract Matroid interdiction problems are well-researched in the field of combinatorial optimization. In the matroid ℓ \ell -interdiction problem, an interdiction strategy removes a subset of cardinality ℓ \ell from the matroid’s ground set. The goal is to maximize the weight of a remaining optimal basis.

pmc-10529666.title: Exposure Assessment of Nitrofuran Metabolites in Fish and Honey Produced in Armenia: A Pilot Investigation
pmc-10529666.creator: Davit Pipoyan, Meline Beglaryan, Victoria Chirkova, Alberto Mantovani, M Carmen Seijo
pmc-10529666.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In Armenia, the presence of nitrofuran residues in food products is unacceptable for both domestic sales and export. However, food may contain nitrofuran metabolites (NMs) due to the illegal use of these drugs in the agrofarming practice. This study aimed to identify NMs as the marker residues for nitrofurans in fish and honey produced in Armenia and assess the potential health risks associated with consuming these foods.

pmc-11269886.title: Gape‐limited invasive predator frequently kills avian prey that are too large to swallow
pmc-11269886.creator: Martin Kastner, Scott M. Goetz, Kayla M. Baker, Shane R. Siers, Eben H. Paxton, Melia G. Nafus, Haldre S. Rogers
pmc-11269886.description: Gape‐limited predators (e.g., snakes, many fish) are not generally expected to pose a predation threat to prey that are too large for them to swallow. However, the extent to which snakes predate on prey that exceed their gape limitation remains largely unknown.

pmc-11346334.title: Seroprevalence and molecular detection of Brucella infection in livestock in the United Arab Emirates
pmc-11346334.creator: Gobena Ameni, Aboma Zewude, Berecha Bayissa, Ibrahim Abdalla Alfaki, Abdallah A. Albizreh, Naeema Alhosani, Khaja Mohteshamuddin, Berhanu Adenew Degefa, Mohamed Elfatih Hamad, Meera Saeed Alkalbani, Mohamed Moustafa Abdelhalim, Assem Sobhi Abdelazim, Rafeek Aroul Koliyan, Kaltham Kayaf, Mervat Mari
pmc-11346334.description: Small ruminants and camels are important livestock species in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), although Brucella infection can limit their productivity. This study aimed to investigate the seroprevalence of Brucella infection and its associated risk factors in small ruminants and camels in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. Additionally, seropositive animals were tested for the DNA of Brucella.

pmc-11653854.title: Amphotericin B Colloidal Dispersion is Efficacious and Safe for the Management of Talaromycosis in HIV-Infected Patients: Results of a Retrospective Cohort Study in China
pmc-11653854.creator: Min Liu, Honghong Yang, Qian Liu, Kun He, Jing Yuan, Yaokai Chen
pmc-11653854.description: BackgroundAmphotericin B deoxycholate (AmB-D) have potential toxic effects in the treatment of talaromycosis, and high-quality, non-generic liposomal AmB (L-AMB) is still inaccessible in many regions of China. As such, the efficacy and safety of alternative drugs warrant further investigation for the management of talaromycosis.

pmc-11975525.title: 产后访视能力的研究进展
pmc-11975525.creator: Guoqing WANG, Xiaoyu LI, Yimei XIE, Wenjie GONG, 柳 宋
pmc-11975525.description: 产后访视是基层妇幼保健人员在产妇出院后1周内到其家中进行的保健服务。然而，中国对此缺乏具体工作细则和标准，难以有效评估产后访视人员能力，提高其服务质量。本文采用主题词加自由词相结合的方式检索中英文数据库，根据纳入和排除标准对检索文献进行筛选，纳入24篇文献，提取并归纳产后访视能力及相关要求。产后访视能力内容可归纳为健康评估、健康教育和沟通协调3个维度。访视人员能够完成基本的产妇和新生儿的身体检查及健康宣教，但在提供更具专业性的保健服务时存在一定的不足。访视人员个人特征、技术能力及培训等影响产后访视服务的交付效果。访视能力提升策略包括教学形式改革、家访技能培训、规范访视程序。目前缺乏全面评估产后访视能力的方法。Keywords: 产后访视, 能力, 影响因素, 提升策略, 评估方法, 妇幼保健 产后访视作为国家基本公共卫生服务中孕产妇健康管理服务的重要内容，是孕期健康管理和住院分娩之后的延伸服务，主要由产妇居住地社区卫生服务中心(站)/乡镇卫生院的基层妇幼保健人员在产妇分娩出院后1周内到产妇家中对其及新生儿进行面对面的保健服务，以完成随访、观察、体格检查和健康指导等服务[1]。高水平、高质量的产后访视，可有效降低产妇及新生儿的死亡率，提高家庭对相关疾病的管理及转诊能力[2]，并提高母乳喂养成功率[3-4]，有效地保障产妇和新生儿的身心健康，是基层妇幼保健的重点工作之一。然而，当前中国缺乏产后访视工作的具体细则，也未制订相应的工作标准，即负责产后访视的保健人员应该具备何种能力及能力水平。产后访视人员能力参差不齐，难以满足产妇及新生儿的保健需求，亟须采取有效的措施提高产后访视能力。因此，本文旨在通过文献回顾，系统阐述产后访视能力的要素、含义、现状、影响因素、提升策略及评估方法，以期为后续相关研究和产后访视能力的提升提供参考。 文献检索及结果 研究者对中国知网、万方、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、PubMed、Embase、Ovid共7个数据库进行检索，检索范围为自建库至2023年7月1日发表的国内外关于产后访视能力文献。中文检索词为“围产期”“围生期”“产后”“孕产妇”“分娩后”“妊娠”“妇女”“产褥期”“新生儿”“婴幼儿”“访视”“家访”“家庭随访”“能力”“技能”“胜任力”“质量”等。英文检索词为“competence”“skill”“home visit”和“postpartum period”等。 文献纳入标准：1)围绕产后访视能力开展的研究；2)经过同行评议的原始研究(包括实证研究、考核、培训、模型框架类研究、定性访谈等)；3)以英文或中文发表的研究。排除标准：1)未在产后42 d内开展访视活动；2)产后访视人员在家访时仅交付研究人员指定的保健服务，而非常规保健服务。本研究经筛选最终得到24篇有效文献，包括11篇中文文献、13篇英文文献。 产后访视能力要素 产后访视能力可以归纳为健康评估、健康教育和沟通协调3个维度。这些能力包含评估产妇及新生儿的身心健康状态，针对性地开展健康教育，完成产后访视安排，处理产后访视信息等(表1)。 表1产后访视能力要求Table 1 测量体温、血压，触诊乳房、子宫底下降程度、腹直肌分离程度，询问恶露情况、腹部或侧切伤口；筛查产妇心理健康状态 识别有无异常情况并转诊 询问喂养方式、24 h喂养次数、喂养量、大便及体重变化情况 测量体重和体温，检查脐带脱落情况、黄疸情况 识别有无异常情况并转诊 指导母婴互动、新生儿喂养技能、新生儿发育特点、新生儿正常行为、新生儿 免疫接种 开展家庭暴力评估与处理、婴儿虐待评估与处理 产后访视能力现状 健康评估 在健康评估方面，超过43%的经认证的社会健康积极分子具备新生儿保健技能[5-7]。Henderson等[8]调查了社区儿童保健护士在产后访视方面的综合能力，发现社区儿童保健护士具备有效规划产后访视安排、评估产妇风险并提供转诊服务以及与产妇建立积极关系的能力。这可能得益于持续性的在职培训和监督机制。既往研究[9]也发现更高的监督水平与更好的家访效果有关。社区卫生人员对新生儿危险体征的识别具有中至高的敏感度，对判断转诊的能力具有高敏感度和特异度，但对于低温治疗的判断存在不足[10]。这提示在更专业的保健服务方面，产后访视人员能力仍有欠缺。 健康教育 在健康教育方面，访视人员在母乳喂养[11]和避孕指导[12]方面存在局限。研究[13]发现产妇对产后访视的需求与实际得到的保健服务之间存在差距。产妇对健康教育的需求主要包括产褥期保健指导、产后心理指导、母乳喂养指导、新生儿保健指导，且经产妇和初产妇的需求存在一定差异[14-16]。为了提高产后访视服务的质量并满足产妇的多样化需求，需深入调查产妇及其家属的需求，以更新产后访视服务项目。此外，由于初产妇和经产妇的服务需求存在差异，需提供个性化保健服务。未来研究可以探索个性化服务包[17]，以满足不同程度的产后保健需求。

pmc-12463935.title: Do the expressions about customarily doing reflect our cognition and emotion: evidence from Chinese BCC corpus
pmc-12463935.creator: Limin Zhang, Zhaojie Lv, Longbo Ren
pmc-12463935.description: Through an in-depth analysis of the Chinese BCC colloquial corpus, this paper discusses the cognitive and emotional features of the temporal contouring of “customarily X” (X refers to verb or adjective) in spoken Chinese, focusing on the two different expressions of “often V” (V= verb) and “be often A” (A= adjective).

pmc-12732402.title: Graphitic Carbon Nitride in Oral Health: Emerging Applications, Antimicrobial Potential, and Future Perspectives
pmc-12732402.creator: Gertrud Alexandra Paltinean, Marioara Moldovan, Codruta Sarosi, Laura Silaghi-Dumitrescu, Stanca Cuc, Gabriel Furtos, Ioan Petean, Irina Camelia Chis
pmc-12732402.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This comprehensive review highlights the growing significance of graphitic carbon nitride (g-C3N4) as a multifunctional material with applications spanning diverse scientific and technological domains. Based on an extensive literature from electronic databases such as Web of Science, PubMed and Google Scholar, we provide an in-depth discussion of the fundamental structural configurations of g-C3N4, namely the triazine- and heptazine-based frameworks, which form the basis of its unique physicochemical and electronic properties.

pmc-13226953.title: From thought to language: Comparing schizophrenia spectrum disorders and Wernicke’s aphasia with machine learning and LLMs
pmc-13226953.creator: Perry van der Zande, Andreas van Cranenburgh, Frank Tsiwah
pmc-13226953.description: Schizophrenia spectrum disorders (SSD) and Wernicke’s aphasia (WA) both disrupt meaningful speech, yet they arise from fundamentally different disturbances in thought and language. SSD is defined by formal thought disorder, in which disorganized thinking is inferred from abnormalities in speech, whereas WA reflects a primary breakdown of language implementation following focal brain damage.

pmc-13680492.title: Systematic evaluation of long-read and short-read sequencing in neurological disorders diagnosis: a direct comparison study of 310 patients
pmc-13680492.creator: Dream Lok Sze Chan, Helen Ying Fung Tam, Amy Hin Yan Tong, Wei Ma, Chak Sing Lau, Ho Ming Luk, Shirley Yin Yu Pang, Shirley Sze Wing Cheng, Yuan Gao, Lai Ting Leung, Denis Long Him Yeung, Claudia Ching Yan Chung, Steve Tsz Fung Chan, Shirley Pik Ying Hue, Anson Man Chun Xi, Dicky Or, Steve Cheuk Yiu
pmc-13680492.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Genetic neurological disorders are highly heterogeneous, and many are driven by complex variants that challenge short‑read genome sequencing (srGS). Long‑read genome sequencing (lrGS) has recently shown promise, but head‑to‑head evaluations are limited. A direct comparison study of srGS and lrGS was performed for 310 families with undiagnosed neurological disorders from the Hong Kong Genome Project to assess their diagnostic performance, technical capabilities and costing. Genome sequencing showed an overall diagnostic yield of 22.6% (n = 70/310, 77 variants).
